h1: B2B Lead Generation Company in Sydney
intro: Looking for a lead generation company in Sydney? Myntmore runs cold email, LinkedIn outreach and ABM for B2B companies selling to Australian buyers, from local firms to Indian companies winning Australian clients. We work remotely from Mumbai, campaigns go live within 18 days, and the first qualified conversations usually arrive in weeks 3 to 4.
whyTitle: Why selling to Sydney needs outbound

why.title: Australia's business centre
why.desc: Sydney holds the headquarters of banks, insurers and many of Australia's largest companies, plus a growing SaaS scene. Their buyers get pitched by suppliers worldwide.

why.title: Rules that reward relevance
why.desc: Australia's Spam Act expects consent, including consent inferred from a published business address when the message fits the person's role. Relevant, targeted outreach is the safe kind.

why.title: A market Indian firms already serve
why.desc: Indian IT, outsourcing and engineering firms work with Australian clients every day. Direct outbound adds clients beyond partners and referrals.

stepsTitle: How B2B lead generation works with us

steps.title: ICP and buying signals
steps.desc: We define who to target and which signals mean they are in-market: funding, new offices, hiring, leadership changes and vendor reviews.

steps.title: Lists, domains and copy
steps.desc: Verified contact lists, dedicated sending domains with warm-up, and copy written for Australian buyers, with a clear sender and an easy unsubscribe.

steps.title: Campaigns go live
steps.desc: Cold email and LinkedIn sequences start sending in Australian Eastern business hours, with account-based plays for named enterprise accounts.

steps.title: Conversations, then consistency
steps.desc: First qualified conversations usually come in weeks 3 to 4, and meeting volume becomes consistent by weeks 6 to 8 as we tune messaging on real replies.

stepsNote: Outreach rules for this market: Australia's Spam Act 2003 requires consent for commercial email, which can be inferred when a business address is conspicuously published and the message relates to the person's role. Every email needs sender details and a working unsubscribe. Read our [cold email compliance guide](/resources/blogs/cold-email-compliance-guide). Comparing agencies?
